sectors.trend: 10-Year yield at 19-year high; brutal bond selloff pressuring equities; spreads with Asia at extremes
sectors.implications: Rising yields compress equity valuations, increase borrowing costs, and signal potential Fed rate hikes. Duration risk is elevated.

sectors.trend: AI boom resilient to higher rates per Goldman; Nvidia, Meta Muse, Palantir, AMD, SK Hynix all active; Jensen Huang dismisses doomsday fears
sectors.implications: AI capex cycle continues but concentration risk is high. Hardware (optics, chips) and software (Palantir, Salesforce) both benefiting.

sectors.trend: Oil above $103 on Iran tensions; Qatar boosting LNG via Hormuz; grains slump post-summit; gold declining
sectors.implications: Energy inflation risk persists. Grains weakness signals weak global demand. Gold underperforming as rate-hike narrative dominates.

sectors.trend: Starbucks closing 250 stores; McDonald's pivoting to AI; Nike facing weak demand; Chewy vs Petco divergence
sectors.implications: Consumer pressure mounting. Companies leveraging AI for efficiency. Premium brands under stress.

sectors.trend: Lockheed Martin spending ahead on JATM; Leonardo DRS wins Korean warship contract; multiyear contracts likely
sectors.implications: Geopolitical tensions (Iran, US-China) sustain defense spending. Structural tailwind for LMT, DRS.

sectors.trend: SEBI opens overseas investment for $463B in funds; Indonesia new economic chiefs vow unity; South Africa new lender challenges banks
sectors.implications: Capital outflow risk from India. Indonesia policy stability positive. South Africa financial liberalization underway.

Market concentration at dot-com levels; bond stress + oil spike create volatility risk

defensive_moves.rationale: Narrow market leadership + rising yields = asymmetric downside risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid China-exposed supply chain names until truce clarity
defensive_moves.rationale: 2-month truce is fragile; summit lacked broader trade details; grains already slumping

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Bond selloff and oil spike create headwinds. Dow down 300+ points. Expect volatility as markets digest yield spike. AI names may provide relative strength but broad market under pressure. 1-3 month: 5-10% correction risk if yields break higher.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI capex cycle intact per Goldman. US-China truce provides 2-month runway. Defense spending structural. However, concentration risk and inflation persistence cap upside. 6-12 month: recovery likely if oil stabilizes and Fed pauses.
